redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest` in a throwaway tree at HEAD: the run timed out after 256 s and its process group was torn down; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: R91: drive-phase.py signal_line no longer drops the clauses did_events reads. New read_clauses() carries every start and close as one comma word per verb (join_ids: ids after the first that share its phase written from the '.', e.g. P125.54-0h5,.55-0h5), each fix-task added-for clause, and sign-off/landing/release once each; they are never dropped. The next: field falls back to the shorter --explain command and the basis and the other clauses (fit_rest, with +N) take what room is left. A step whose read events alone exceed SIGNAL_BYTES prints them whole past the bound (sn8b), documented in signal_line's docstring. did_tasks reads the comma word via split_ids and still reads plain did-lines (one id after the word); did_events shares _is_fix_added. The .explain route was rejected: tools/stream-cost.py reads did_events off the tool result in the transcript after the fact, and the .explain file is overwritten by the next signal, so stream-cost needed no change. R92: DISPATCH_PROMPT now carries --manifest "<abs manifest>" --project-dir "<abs project>" before --role <role> and the id; dispatch_prompt takes ctx; brief gains a --manifest option (the positional must come after the id, which must stay last), refusing two different manifests. Tests: sn8 now requires every read event on every corpus line (corpus done lines carry a sign-off did-line; expectations written out, not parsed); sn8b covers the over-bound case; sn2u asserts the absolute manifest/project; sn4's template carries <manifest>/<project>; sn6 runs the command parsed (shlex) from the --explain prompt line as a subprocess from a git worktree of the fixture with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR removed. Red on today's driver (before the fix): sn8 FAIL (decide-gate-coverage line kept closed P125.54-0h5 and started P125.55-0h5 then +6) and sn6 FAIL (all four briefs 'exit 2: drive-phase.py: no brief to print'), 10/12 in the sn-block+sn5-block stages. After: python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest exit 0, ALL PASS 302/302; python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py exit 0, 335/335 files ok, 16375 cases; python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --encoding cp1252 exit 0, 335/335 files ok, both halves ran. Outside the declared files: commands/phase.md (sn4 compares it to DISPATCH_PROMPT) and commands/next.md, run.md, review.md, resume.md, which state the same prompt sentence; the plan gate allowed each edit. Not edited: tools/measure-context.py and reference/orchestrator.md describe the command loosely as 'brief --role <role> <id>'. Not run: measure-context --gate (the command bodies grew by about 50 bytes each), ruff, vermin.
outcome.descriptive: The signal line no longer drops the start/close/fix/sign-off/landing/release events stream-cost reads, and the dispatch prompt names the manifest and project so a brief prints from a wave tree with no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
